name: GPU Marching Cubes
definition: A GPU-based implementation of the marching cubes algorithm that uses a compute shader to generate triangle vertices for a scalar field (metaballs) on a fixed 3D grid.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes extracts isosurfaces from 3D scalar fields using compute shaders for massive parallelism, differing from CPU methods by simultaneous grid processing and from traditional pipelines by generating geometry into storage buffers.
